Star data: HYG Database v4.1 by David Nash / Astronexus and contributors.
Source: https://github.com/astronexus/HYG-Database/blob/main/hyg/CURRENT/hygdata_v41.csv
License: CC BY-SA 4.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
Derived catalog: src/data/stars.json. Same CC BY-SA 4.0 license applies to this derived data.
Processing: excluded the Sun; retained apparent magnitude <=6; fields are
J2000 right ascension (degrees), declination (degrees), magnitude, B-V color index.
Coordinates rounded to five decimals; missing B-V indices set to neutral 0.
The starting orientation is illustrative, not tied to an observation date.
